required_knowns.claim: Pre-flight verifies the parsed spec, then persists approved state, its spec hash and the captured HEAD baseline.
Explicit post-flight resumes with stored state but parses the current spec and audits it against the saved baseline.
A spec-hash mismatch prints a warning. It neither blocks nor requires new pre-flight verification before the audit.
The edited contract controls audit scope. Widening touches can remove an UnexpectedFile finding without renewed pre-flight approval. It does not guarantee Held.
On the would-be Held path, post-flight stability checks cover changes during that phase. A successful Held path can still write release/history artifacts and require semantic review.
